source: Frozen 1700–2010 225 butterfly × 51 original GSHHG landmass port-host × uniform marine-access refit
what_this_is: Independent literature triage for the entire fixed 3+5 host-indexed after-1700 historical source-first candidate sample, not chosen by ecological outcome

evidence_classes.HISTORICAL_ISLAND_OCCURRENCE: Dated or before-2001 published report of species on the same whole GSHHG landmass; disqualifies as first-known island appearance but NOT necessarily as recent recolonization
evidence_classes.PUBLISHED_PRE2001_ISLAND_REPORT: Earlier island report available in historical synthesis but original specimen and date not independently recovered; cannot call it post-2010 first island observation
evidence_classes.SOURCE_CONFLICT_NEEDS_RECORD_VALIDATION: Current later GBIF index inconsistent with regional-checklist descriptions; original occurrence taxon and locality need verification
evidence_classes.NO_ESTABLISHMENT_VERIFICATION: Occurrence could be a vagrant or a recent record, but no verified historical arrival or breeding evidence

inference_limits: All eight source-defined GBIF initial indexes are indexed observation events, NOT confirmed new butterfly arrivals or population establishment
GBIF historic 1700–2000 nonindex can coexist with older published insect literature not ingested into GBIF
Published historic presence does not rule out later recolonization, nor specify migration route or carrier
The whole Great Britain and Ireland landmasses are geographic supports, not local port plots
The last three require raw GBIF record/provenance verification before an island population inference
This sample is response/exposure-selected; fractions are NOT population prevalence of GBIF-index error
